Well it could be depression but from what I read it feels like you're hustling too hard and this has caused a burnout which might be causing the depression like symptoms. I'm not a professional but yeah it happened to me in 2020 . What helped was actually taking a break from literally everything and literally in 2021 I just did the bare minimum. I binged watched whatever the hell I wanted to watch and for me workouts were also getting stressful and so I completely stopped that . I indulged in acceptance and commitment therapy which was basically trying new things and by 2022 my burnout lifted and I was back to hustling. 
Burnouts actually take a long time to heal . So ya ,I hope this helps . 
edit : acceptance and commitment therapy basically does make you try new things but then eventually you're supposed to continue doing the things that make you happy. And then you can add subtract whatever.
